jobs.title: Geotechnical Professional Staff Geologist/Staff Engineer-Tacoma
jobs.description:
Certerra is a growing national provider of testing, inspection, and certification services that support innovation in new product development, quality assurance, for project delivery, and engineered solutions for asset management. We are passionate about contributing to the sustainable development of the communities we serve. We are a national firm with a global reach serving national and international clients from 30\+ offices located in 10 states and are ranked on ENR’s Top 500 list alongside the nation’s top firms. With a 60\-year history, Certerra has a passion for high\-end services, constant innovation, and investment in the development of world\-class laboratory facilities, and interactive management technologies. Each member of our staff is committed to service, innovation, and the success of our clients.


Certerra is a nationally recognized provider of engineering, testing, inspection, and certification services supporting innovation, quality assurance, and resilient infrastructure. With over 1,800 professionals nationwide, we combine technical expertise with practical field knowledge to ensure the communities we serve are built to last.

**Help Build Our South Puget Sound Geotechnical Team**


Certerra is growing our Tacoma office and laboratory, strategically located to serve South Puget Sound and some of the region's largest and most technically challenging infrastructure, military, federal, transportation, and civil construction projects.


We're looking for an experienced geotechnical professional – geologist, engineering geologist, geological engineer, geotechnical engineer, or similarly qualified professional – to become a key member of this growing team.

**Washington LG or PE licensure is highly desirable, but we also encourage highly qualified candidates who are eligible for or actively progressing toward professional licensure to apply.**


Our South Puget Sound team supports a diverse and growing portfolio of work, including military and federal projects at Naval Base Kitsap and other regional installations, Sound Transit and transportation programs, major civil infrastructure, dams and water resources, commercial development, and other complex construction throughout Western Washington.


This is a hands\-on technical role spanning both design\-phase geotechnical investigations and construction\-phase support, with a strong emphasis on evaluating and documenting actual soil and rock conditions encountered during construction.

**We're looking for someone with approximately five or more years of relevant experience who is comfortable moving between the field and office, exercising professional judgment, working directly with construction teams, and turning field observations into clear technical documentation and recommendations.**

**Environmental experience is also highly desirable and provides an opportunity to help expand our capabilities in the South Puget Sound market.**

**Duties:**


The successful candidate will work across geotechnical design, field investigation, and construction, with a significant portion of the role focused on construction\-phase geotechnical services.

**Typical responsibilities may include**:

* Provide geotechnical and engineering geology support during major civil, military, federal, transportation, and infrastructure construction
* Observe, evaluate, and document soil and rock conditions encountered during excavation and construction
* Confirm field conditions relative to design assumptions, plans, specifications, and geotechnical recommendations
* Perform detailed soil and rock logging, mapping, and conditions documentation
* Observe and document foundation excavations, bearing conditions, slopes, excavations, and other geotechnically significant construction activities
* Observe and document rock and soil anchor systems, including drilling and installation
* Document drilling conditions, materials encountered, depths, groundwater, refusals, and other relevant subsurface conditions
* Identify and communicate differing or unexpected field conditions to engineers, contractors, owners, and project teams
* Support geotechnical instrumentation and monitoring activities, including settlement, groundwater, vibration, and other monitoring programs
* Plan and perform subsurface investigations, including drilling, test pits, sampling, and field exploration
* Review field and laboratory data and develop or support geotechnical recommendations
* Support foundation, earthwork, site development, and geologic hazard evaluations
* Prepare field memoranda, technical reports, recommendations, proposals, and other project documentation
* Provide technical direction and mentoring to geotechnical technicians and junior field personnel
* Support groundwater and environmental investigations based on experience
* Assist with project management, client coordination, budgets, schedules, and technical deliverables


This combination of design, construction, environmental, and monitoring work reflects the broader geotechnical professional role identified for Certerra Northwest, including subsurface investigations, geologic hazard assessments, foundation recommendations, earthwork evaluations, construction support, instrumentation and monitoring, groundwater evaluations, and environmental investigations.

**Education/Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Geology, Engineering Geology, Geological Engineering, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, or a related field
* Approximately five or more years of relevant professional experience
* Washington Licensed Geologist (LG) or Professional Engineer (PE) preferred
* Demonstrated experience with both design\-phase geotechnical investigations and construction\-phase geotechnical support
* Strong soil and rock identification, logging, evaluation, and documentation skills

jobs.title: Environmental Scientist
jobs.description:
**Environmental Research Group, LLC (ERG)** is seeking an Environmental Scientist to join our Environmental Compliance Team to support a variety of environmental compliance projects. When not performing work at various project sites, this position can be based anywhere in the USA with preference given to candidates that reside within an hour commute of a regional or international airport.


The Environmental Scientist is expected to support and lead a variety of projects, working both independently and as part of a team. An experienced multi\-disciplinary background is valued for this position. You will plan and execute technical projects, conduct regulatory research, write reports, support permitting process, conduct site visits and surveys, and collaborate with a team, while remaining flexible to prioritize clients' needs and deadlines.


This position requires traveling on average one week per month for fieldwork and site visits, with durations of 3 to 14 days on site. Some international travel would be required with this position. The field work can include working indoors, outdoors, and/or industrial locations, and wearing Level D Personal Protective Equipment.


Founded in 2000, ERG provides environmental compliance, natural resources, and cultural resources consulting services. We are a value\-driven, employee\-first, government small business contractor. Trust, expertise, and compassion drive our success, while gratitude, joy, and adaptability drive the team.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Environmental Engineering, Environmental Science, or a closely related field. Master's degree, Professional Engineer, and/or relevant certifications are a plus.
* Working knowledge of federal environmental programs. Knowledge and experience with Department of War (DoW) environmental policy is a plus.
* Excellent interpersonal communication, writing skills, and attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently, manage time efficiently, and be responsive.
* Flexibility to serve in multiple roles and teams depending on the client and project.
* Must be able to pass DoW security clearances and background checks and obtain a passport.
* US citizenship required.

**Knowledge and Experience**

* The position requires experience with multiple federal and state environmental regulatory areas, with a focus in one or more programs including but not limited to environmental compliance auditing and inspections; Environmental Management System; solid waste, toxic substances, spill response, stormwater, wastewater, hazardous materials, hazardous waste, storage tanks, air quality, and/or resilience.
* Experience with environmental auditing and public involvement are a plus.
* Experience in preparing and writing environmental plans, permits, and reports, and conducting environmental audits to ensure compliance with federal, state, and local requirements.
* Experience in providing environmental project support to clients, including conducting site visits as needed. Work experience with federal government agencies, DoW, and state environmental agencies.
* Relevant environmental and technical certifications and trainings are a plus.


The annual salary range for this position is $80,000\-$90,000, commensurate with experience, and bonuses are offered for exceptional performance. The benefits package includes health insurance with a generous employer subsidy, eleven paid holidays, paid time off, fitness stipend, and a 401(k) plan with an employer contribution regardless of employee contribution, and more. If you feel you have what it takes to be successful in this opportunity, please apply through our job board: https://envrg.isolvedhire.com/jobs/.


Successful candidates should be prepared to submit a writing sample.


ERG is an Equal Opportunity Employer including Disability and Veteran statuses. ERG also participates in the U.S. Department of Homeland Security's E\-Verify Program to ensure that all employees hired are legally able to work in the United States.

jobs.title: Responder / Environmental Scientist, Engineer
jobs.description:
**The Opportunity**  

Tetra Tech is looking for **a full\-time, mid\-level, Responder / Environmental Scientist, Engineer** for our **Denver, CO** office. This is not a remote position.

 **Position Summary**  

The selected candidate will join a growing and energetic team supporting environmental projects in the Rocky Mountain region of the U.S. This is a great opportunity to be involved in all facets of environmental management.

 **Essential Job Functions (Required)**  

The following duties are considered essential to the role. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions:

* Support and lead field work for Federal and Private clients, including project management, budgeting, and scheduling.
* Provide technical support to a long\-term U.S. Environmental Protection Agency contract in the areas of site investigation, Brownfields redevelopment, removal assessment, data management, and emergency response.
* Work includes a broad range of site types from abandoned properties to mine sites, to industrial/commercial facilities, orphaned wells, to spills \- with work locations across Colorado, Montana, North Dakota, South Dakota, Utah, and Wyoming.
* Oversee and conduct multi\-media sampling, field audits and inspections, use of a range of field monitoring equipment, organizing and reviewing data, preparing reports and maps, file reviews, collection of air monitoring data, training and exercise support, contractor oversight, task and project management, and related services.
* Lead a field team, including leading health and safety activities, sampling, and data collection and reporting.
* Perform tasks across multiple disciplines to bring about successful project completion
* Demonstrate full knowledge of each project’s status and goals
* Emergency response work includes mobilizing to spill or response sites and work with EPA and other parties to support air monitoring, sampling, communications support, and data management.
* Understand and use of environmental monitoring equipment
* Work in Levels A, B, C and D PPE

 **Why Tetra Tech**  

At Tetra Tech, we are Leading with Science to solve the world’s most complex challenges. Our industry\-leading experts in engineering and consulting are committed to driving positive change in communities around the world. For over 60 years, we have been at the forefront of innovation and sustainability. Today we stand as a market leader, offering cutting\-edge solutions in water, environment, energy, and international development. Our work has improved more than 625 million lives around the world.

**Your Impact**  

Join Tetra Tech to make a real difference. Our work leverages cutting\-edge technologies, advanced analytics, and the expertise of world\-class scientists and engineers to create meaningful change around the world. Discover your full potential – join us to advance your career while leaving a lasting legacy.

 **Required Qualifications (Required)**  

* B.S./B.A. in Geology, Chemistry, Engineering, Biology, Geography or other related environmental science
* Years of Experience: 7\+ years
* The position requires periodic on\-call support, up to two weeks per month. The ability to respond quickly, within a mandatory response time, is required.
* Ability to travel, including overnight and weekends.
* Demonstrated ability to organize, coordinate, analyze, and present technical material.
* Excellent writing skills that include the ability to read and assimilate technical and scientific information.
* Ability to learn quickly and multi\-task.
* Highly motivated, customer focused
* Work well in a team environment.
* Ability to work independently and under direct on\-site supervision.
* Ability to manage a heavy workload
* Excellent communication, client interaction, and organizational skills.
* Strong educational and work foundation
* Ability to wear Level D\-B PPE

In addition, the following is required:  

* Background check
**Preferred Qualifications**  

* 40\-hour OSHA HAWOPER training
* Completion of ICS 100, 200, 700, and 800 training
* Asbestos and lead certification


You will preferably have experience with some or all of the following:  

* Hydrogeological investigations
* Hazardous materials surveys (including asbestos, lead\-based paint)
* Analytical data using spreadsheets and databases
* Conceptual remedial action plans and remedial cost estimates
* Phase I ESAs to ASTM or higher standards
* Phase II ESAs
* Mastery with MS Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Access) is strongly desired.
* Fluency in Spanish (spoken and written) is preferred but not required.
 **Work Environment/Environmental Factors (Required)**


This position requires up to 70% travel to support environmental emergency response situations throughout the Mountain Region, on short notice, where the applicant will be a part of field teams and provide technical support to EPA personnel at a range of site investigation and response sites.


You must be able to mobilize for emergency response efforts from our warehouse in Arvada, CO within 2 hours when you are on\-call. Periodic on\-call support is up to two weeks per month. The ability to respond quickly, within a mandatory response time, is required.

 **Physical Requirements (Required)**  

The physical demands described here represent those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodations may be made.  

* Walk on uneven terrain
* Lift and carrying objects up to 50 lbs.
* Wear and work in an air purifying respirator and self\-contained breathing apparatus (SCBA).
* Work periodic long days, including 12\+ hours, especially when in the field, including evenings and weekends.
* Work outside in all weather conditions, both hot and cold and inclement weather
* Work around or with chemical and biological hazards.
* Drive on a regular basis.
* Passing a motor vehicle record b

jobs.title: Data Analyst II
jobs.description:
Overview:

Goldbelt Professional Services specializes in providing expert resources for Public Health missions including scientific, technical, and administrative support from junior staff to high\-level subject matter experts. Research and data driven, Goldbelt Professional Services’ experts create solutions customized to the client’s needs.  

**Summary:**
The Data Analyst II supports the mission of the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), National Center on Birth Defects and Developmental Disabilities (NCBDDD), by providing data management, statistical analysis, surveillance support, and reporting for multi\-state birth defects surveillance activities. The position works closely with epidemiologists, surveillance program staff, information technology specialists, and state health departments to ensure the quality, integrity, timeliness, and accuracy of public health data used to inform research, prevention strategies, and public health decision\-making.
Responsibilities:
**Essential Job Functions:*** Provide data management, statistical analysis, surveillance support, and reporting to support national surveillance of birth defects and other infant disorders.
* Sort, clean, validate, and analyze birth defects/infant disorder data collected from surveillance systems.
* Conduct routine and ad hoc statistical analyses of surveillance data, including prevalence ratio calculations, trend analyses, regression modeling, and other epidemiologic analyses across multiple jurisdictions.
* Use advanced statistical programming languages and software, including SAS, R, SQL, and related analytical tools, to manage and analyze large, complex public health datasets.
* Generate weekly reports, tables, datasets, and data products in multiple formats (e.g., SAS, CSV, XML) for CDC program staff and stakeholders.
* Establish and maintain database variable structures and data management systems to support multi\-state surveillance data submissions to CDC.
* Develop, implement, and monitor data quality assurance and quality control protocols to identify, investigate, and resolve data quality issues.
* Review surveillance data submissions from surveillance programs and provide technical recommendations to improve data completeness, consistency, and accuracy.
* Collaborate with Information Technology (IT) staff to establish, document, and maintain data reporting mechanisms and automated data workflows.
* Prepare and maintain documentation supporting Human Subjects protections, Institutional Review Board (IRB) requirements, Assurances of Confidentiality (AoC), and other regulatory compliance activities.
* Develop and maintain surveillance database documentation, including data dictionaries, file specifications, metadata standards, and data cleaning procedures.
* Identify opportunities for program and process improvements that enhance the timeliness, quality, and accuracy of surveillance data and analytic outputs.
* Prepare written reports, oral presentations, technical documentation, analytic summaries, and recommendations for CDC leadership, program staff, and external partners.
* Collaborate with epidemiologists, researchers, and public health professionals to support surveillance activities, scientific publications, presentations, and program evaluation efforts.


Qualifications:
**Necessary Skills and Knowledge:*** Public Health data analytics, particularly Birth Defects and Developmental Disabilities Surveillance and neonatal abstinence syndrome surveillance
* Statistical programming (SAS, R, SQL, Python)
* Regression modeling and trend analysis
* Data visualization and reporting (Tableau, Power BI)
* CDC Surveillance and Reporting Systems
* Ability to Translate Complex Data into Actionable Insights
* Database Management and Data Warehousing
* Data Cleaning, Validation, and Quality Assessment
* Analytical and Critical Thinking
* Strategic Data Interpretation
* Research and Evaluation Methodology
* Strong Written and Oral Communication
* Collaboration Across Multidisciplinary Teams
* Relationship Building with State and Federal Partners

**Minimum Qualifications:*** Master's degree pr PhD in Public Health, Epidemiology, Biostatistics, Data Science, or a related discipline.
* 5\+ years of relevant experience
* Experience supporting birth defects surveillance, maternal and child health programs, developmental disabilities research, or chronic disease surveillance.
* Familiarity with CDC data standards, human subjects protections, IRB processes, and federal data governance requirements.
* Experience working with multi\-state surveillance systems and collaborating with state health departments and public health partners.

**Preferred Qualifications:*** Master's degree pr PhD in Public Health, Epidemiology, Biostatistics, Data Science, or a related discipline.
* 8\+ years of relevant experience
* Experience supporting birth defects surveillance, maternal and child health programs, developmental disabilities research, or chronic disease surveillance.
* Familiarity with CDC data standards and federal data governance requirements.
* Experience working with multi\-state surveillance systems and collaborating with state health departments and public health partners.

 **Pay and Benefits**
The salary range for this position is $85,000\-$105,000 annually.  

At Goldbelt, we value and reward our team's dedication and hard work. We provide a competitive base salary commensurate with your qualifications and experience. As an employee, you'll enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with company matching, tax\-deferred savings options, supplementary benefits, paid time off, and professional development opportunities.
